Guides to the area

A weekend in the Penedès from Barcelona: cava, Montserrat and a night among the vineyards

A two-night plan for two, 45 minutes from Barcelona: cava cellars in Sant Sadurní d'Anoia on Saturday, 15 minutes away; Montserrat on Sunday, 45 away; and the nights in an 1898 village house among vineyards, from 152 € for both nights.

Updated 29 October 2026

The Penedès is the wine region closest to Barcelona, and El Bedorc sits right next to it, in the Anoia. This plan is by car: Friday afternoon, back on Sunday.

Friday: getting there

Barcelona to El Bedorc is about 45 minutes by car, and Barcelona airport (El Prat) about 50. Check-in is from 3 pm. Before dinner there is time to walk the village's eight streets (what to see in El Bedorc).

Saturday: cava in Sant Sadurní

Sant Sadurní d'Anoia is 15 minutes away. Almost every cellar asks you to book:

  • Codorníu, with its modernista building by Puig i Cadafalch. The new guided visit of 2026, «La memoria de la burbuja», costs 38 €.
  • Freixenet: about 90 minutes, with a tasting at the end.
  • For small cellars, the Cava Centre at the tourist office arranges combined visits (+34 938 913 188).

If there is a tasting, the one who doesn't drink should drive. In the afternoon, the paths among the vineyards start at the door. The house restaurant opens on the days announced on the website: if Saturday is one, book a table.

Sunday: Montserrat

Check-out is until 11 am, and Montserrat is 45 minutes away. You can drive up to the monastery, or leave the car in Monistrol and take the rack railway. The Escolania choir sings in the basilica: check the day's times at escolania.cat. If you want to walk, the Rosary path down to the Santa Cova is 1.7 km. How to get up and what to do: the Montserrat guide.

What it costs

A room for two with private bathroom (Les Vinyes or Figarot) is 80 € a night on Friday and Saturday, and with the 5 % discount for two nights it comes to 152 €. An apartment with a kitchen (Montserrat or La Pineda, up to 3 people), 209 €. These are October 2026 prices; today's are on the booking page. Cellar visits and Montserrat are extra.
